XLR cable on channel 4 crackling

Status
open
Symptom
cable-crackle
First seen
2026-05-04
Equipment
XLR cables (pool)

What's happening

During the 9 AM service on May 4, channel 4 (worship leader's vocal mic) started crackling about 20 minutes in. We swapped the cable and the spare worked fine. The bad cable is in the "needs replacement" bin in the booth.

What's been tried

  • Swapped the cable mid-service; the spare worked fine
  • Bad cable was labeled and put aside
